conventions.convention: Momentum space is M = R³ minus the origin, with ω(k) = |k| and dν = d³k/(2|k|). Transversality uses the complex-bilinear dot product; the Hermitian integral pairing is linear in its second variable.
The cross product has ε123 = 1; h(n) = i n× and Pσ = (P + σh)/2, with σ = ±1. The differential domain consists of smooth compactly supported transverse fields on M.

Rotations act by U(R)f(k) = Rf(R⁻¹k). For positive ℏ, U(Ra(t)) = exp(-itJa/ℏ). The displayed differential expression is the restriction of the self-adjoint Stone generator to the smooth domain; no core assertion is made here.
S² has outward orientation. With eσ = (eθ + iσeφ)/√2, Aσ = -i eσ†deσ and Ωσ = iFσ. The normalized Berry flux is 2σ, while the stipulated Chern-Weil convention gives c₁ = -2σ.
The Hilbert and measure constructions assume Countable Choice. The rotation theorem assumes full Choice for Stone's theorem.

load_bearing.statement: Each Pσ(n) is a rank-one orthogonal projector on the complex transverse plane, h has eigenvalue σ on its range, and these ranges form smooth complex line subbundles. The smooth compactly supported transverse domain is dense in H_T^ν.
Assuming Countable Choice, Wf(k) = f(k)/√(2|k|) is a unitary map from the transverse space with measure d³k/(2|k|) onto the transverse space with Lebesgue measure d³k.

Assuming Choice and ℏ > 0, U(R)f(k) = Rf(R⁻¹k) is a strongly continuous unitary representation preserving both helicity projectors. Its self-adjoint Stone generators restrict on the smooth transverse domain to Ja = La + Sa^op; the separate orbital and spin terms generally do not preserve transversality.

Assuming Countable Choice and the stated outward orientation and connection conventions, the helicity line has normalized Berry flux 2σ and first Chern number -2σ. Neither helicity line admits a global smooth unit section; no nontriviality claim is made about the rank-two transverse complex bundle.
